name: Gion Matsuri float procession paid seats
intro: The Gion Matsuri is Kyoto's biggest festival, held throughout July. Its highlights are the processions of huge decorated floats on July 17 and July 24. Paid seats along the route give you a reserved view, and front rows and premium seats go first.

facts.price: ¥6,000 to ¥8,000 for general seats (2026); premium seats cost much more
facts.bookAhead: About six weeks: 2026 seats went on sale on June 1

statusNote: The 2026 sale date is from the Kyoto City Tourism Association's official site. The 2027 date is not announced yet; we show the 2026 date as a guide.
howToBuy: The Kyoto City Tourism Association sells paid seats along the route of the float processions on July 17 and July 24.
In 2026, seats went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on June 1, for both processions. Follow the link on the official page to buy online, or buy at Seven-Eleven stores in Japan.
Seats in the front row and the premium seats go first.
rulesToKnow: The 2027 sale date has not been announced. We will update this page when it is.

soldOut.label: Watch from the street for free: the procession route is public, but arrive early for a good spot

faq.q: When do Gion Matsuri seats go on sale?
faq.a: In 2026 they went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on June 1. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

faq.q: Do I need a seat to see the Gion Matsuri floats?
faq.a: No. Anyone can watch from the street for free. Paid seats give you a reserved spot on the route.

sources.quote: went on sale at 10:00 AM JST, June 1 (Mon), 2026
